Hewaa diraw Abrahaame, «Med'ina Goday immana» yaagiide he sa'aa suntseedda; hachche gakkanaasikka, «Med'inaa Godaa deriyaan imettana» geetettee.
Med'inaa Godaa kiitanchchay saluwaappe laa"entsiide Abrahaama s'eesiide yaageedda;
«Med'ina Goday, ‹Hawaadan yaagaade new taani ta huup'iyaan c'aak'k'ay; neeni hawaa ootseedda dirawunne ne mes's'i itti na'aakka taana diggabeenna diraw,
taani neena tumu anjjana; ne zeretsaakka taani saluwaa s'oolinttiyaa keenanne abbaa doonaa shafiyaa keena ootsaade c'orissana. Ne zeretsatuu barenttu morkkatuwaa katamatuwaa laattana.
Neeni taw azazetteedda diraw, ha sa'aa kawutetsatuu ubbay ne zeretsaa baggana anjjettana› yaagee» yaageedda.
Hewaappe guyye, Abrahaame bare k'oomatuwaakko simmiide, unttunttu ubbay ittippe Berssaabehe denddiide beeddino. Abrahaame Berssaabehen de'eedda.
Hewaappe simmiide Abrahaamew, «Milkka ne ishaa Naakooraw naanaa yelaaddu;
unttunttune bayiray Uus'a; Uus'a ishatuu Buuza,
Araama aawuwaa K'amu'eela, Keesade, Haazo, Pilddaasha, Yidilaafanne Baatu'eela.
Hawantta ha hosppun naanaakka Milkka Abrahaame ishaa Naakooraw yelaaddu; Baatu'eeli Ribik'o yeleedda.
Raa'uma giyaa Aa k'oomata k'ay S'ebaaha, Gahaama, Tahaashanne Maa'ika yelaaddu» yaagiide odeeddino.

notes.text: + Med'ina Goday immana: Med'inaa Goday s'eelee.

heading: Yisaak'a Barew Yarshshanaadan // S'oossay Abrahaama Azazeedda

verses.text: Saara s'eetanne laatamanne laappun laytsaa de'aaddu.
Hewaappe guyye iza Kanaane gadiyaan de'iyaa (Kebroone giyaa) K'iriyaati-Arbba'a kataman hayk'k'aaddu. Abrahaame Saariw yeekkanawunne kayyottanaw beedda.
Yeekki simmiide, Abrahaame bare machchatti anhaa mataappe denddi biide, Hiitetuwaa hawaadan yaageedda;
«Taani hinttenttu giddon betenne imatsaa; ta machchatti anhaa mooganaw taw hinttenttu gadiyaappe duufuwaa zal"eerikkitee!» yaageedda.

Hiitetuu aw, «Godaw, nuuni odiyaawaa sisa; neeni nu giddon wolk'k'aama kaappuwaa; neeni ne machchatti anhaa nu duufuwaappe new lo"eeddawaan mooga; neeni ne machchatti anhaa mooganaw bare duufuwaa ooninne neena diggenna» yaagi zaareeddino.
Yaagina Abrahaame denddi ek'k'iide, Hiitetuwaa sintsan goynneedda.

I unttunttoo, «Hinttenttu taana, ‹Ne machchatti anhaa mooga› gooppe sisite; S'ohaara na'aa Efiroonaw Aa gadiyaa gas'an de'iyaa Maakip'eela giyaa gonggoluwaa taw duufuwaa kessanaw zal"ana mala kumentsaa gatiyaan nuuna zal"iseerikkite» yaageedda.
Hiitiyaa Efiroone he wode katamaa penggiyaan shiik'eedda bare asaa giddon utteedda; Hiitetuu ubbay sisishshin, Abrahaamew yaageedda;
«Hewaadan gidenna; ta godaw, ta odiyaawaa sisa; taani gadiyaakka Aa giddon de'iyaa gonggoluwaakka new immay; taani new Aa ta asaa sintsan immay; neeni ne machchatti anhaa mooga» yaageedda.
Abrahaame he gade asaa sintsan zaaretsi goynneedda,
asay sisishshin Efiroona, «Ta odiyaawaa sisaarikkii! Taani he gadiyaa gatiyaa c'iggana; neeni taappe akkaarikkii! Hewaan taani ta machchatti anhaa moogana» yaageedda.
Efiroone Abrahaamew zaariide, «Ta godaw, taani odiyaawaa sisa; gadii oyddu s'eetu s'agaraa biraa kessiyaawaa; shin hewe ne giddoninne ta giddon ayinne gidenna; ne machchatti anhaa mooga» yaageedda.
Abrahaame Hiitetuu sisishshin, Efiroone geedda gatiyaa mayyeedda; he wode shaluwaan oyddu s'eetu s'agaraa biraa Efiroonaw immeedda.
Mamire katamaa matan Maakip'eelan de'iyaa Efiroona gadii, hewan de'iyaa gonggoluunne he gadiyaan de'iyaa mitsaa ubbay,
katamaa penggiyaan shiik'eedda Hiitetuwaa ubbaa sintsan higgiyaan Abrahaame gade gideedda.
Hewaappe guyye, Abrahaame bare machchatto Saaro Kanaane gadiyaan (Kebroone giyaa) Mamire katamaa matan de'iyaa Maakip'eela giyaa gade gonggoluwaan moogeedda.
Hewaa diraw he gadiinne hewaan de'iyaa gonggoluu Hiitetuwaa sintsan higgiyaan Abrahaamew duufuwaa gideedda.

notes.text: + Oyddu s'eetu s'agaraa biraa: Hawe oyddu kiilo giraamenne bakkaa dees'ee.

verses.text: Abrahaame loytsi laytsaa sugiide c'imeedda; Med'ina Goday Aa ubbabankka anjjeedda.
Abrahaame bare k'oomaa, bare soo asaa ubbaw kaappotiyaa, bare asaa ubbaw godattiyaawaa hawaadan yaageedda; «Ne kushiyaan ta gulbbataa oyk'k'a;
taani unttunttu giddon de'iyaa Kanaanetuwaa mac'c'a naanatuwaappe ta na'aw machchatto oochchenna mala, Med'inaa Godaan, saluwaa S'oossaaninne sa'aa S'oossan taani neena c'aak'k'etsay;
shin neeni ta yeletteedda biittaa, ta dabbotuwaakko baade, ta na'aa Yisaak'aw machchatto oochcha» yaageedda.
Aa k'oomay, «Mac'c'aanna taananna yaanaw dosennabaa gidooppe, ne na'aa neeni yeedda gadiyaa guyye afoo?» yaagiide oochcheedda.
Abrahaame, «Ta na'aa yaa afenaadan neena era!

Med'ina Goday, saluwaa S'oossay, taana ta aawuwaa sooppenne ta yeletteedda biittaappe keseeddawe taw, ‹Ne zariyaw taani ha biittaa immana› yaagiide c'aak'k'eeddawe, neeni ta na'aw yaappe machchatto demmana mala, I bare kiitanchchaa neeppe sintsaw kiittana.
Mishirata neenana guyye yaanaw dosennabaa gidooppe, ha taani neena c'aak'k'etseedda c'aak'uu new gometenna; shin ta na'aa yaa guyye ubbakka afoppa» yaageedda.
K'oomay bare godaa Abrahaame gulbbataa oyk'k'eedda; ha yewoo c'aak'k'eedda.
Hewaappe guyye, k'oomay bare godaa gaalotuwaappe tammuwaa akkiidde, bare godaa miishshaappekka muruta murutaa akkiidde beedda; Masp'p'es'oomiyaa giyaa gadiyaan Naakoora katamaa gakkeedda.
Omarssi, mac'c'a Asay haatsaa tikkanaw yiyaa wodiyaan, katamaappe gas'an haatsaa ollaa matan bare gaalotuwaa gulbbatisseedda.
Yaatiide I hawaadan yaagiide woosseedda; «Med'inaa Godaw, ta godaa Abrahaame S'oossaw, hachche taani k'oppaade yeeddabaa taw injjeya; k'ay ta godaa Abrahaamew lo"obaa ootsa.
Be'a! Taani ha haatsaa pulttiyaa matan ek'k'ay; ha katamaa asaa mac'c'a naanay haatsaa tikkanaw haa yaana.

Taani, ‹Ane otuwaa hokisaadde taana haatsaa ushsha› giyaa wode, izakka, ‹Hey usha; k'ay ne gaaluwaa taani ushshana› yaagiyaanna, henna ne k'oomaa Yisaak'aw neeni dooreeddaano gidu; neeni ta godaw lo"obaa ootseeddawaa taani hewaan erana» yaageedda.
Biro I woosaa wurissenaan de'ishshin, Ribik'a haatsaa otuwaa tookkaade puttu gaaddu. Izo Baatu'eeli yeleedda; Baatu'eeli Milkka na'aa; Milkka Abrahaame ishaa Naakoora machchatto.
Ribik'a loytsa puulanchchanne attuma Asay bochchibeenna wodoratto. Pulttuwaa duge wod'd'aade, bare otuwaa kuntsaade kessaaddu.
He k'oomay iikko wos's'i biide izo, «Ne otuwaappe taana guutsa haatsaa ushshaarikkii!» yaageedda.
Iza, «Eeno ta godaw, ushikkii» yaagaaddu. Elleellaadde otuwaa bare hashiyaappe wotsaade, gede zaara oyk'k'aadde Aa ushshaaddu.
Aa ushsheeddawaappe guyye, «Ne gaalatuwaakka alana gakkanaw taani unttunttoo haatsaa duuk'k'ana» yaagaaddu.

Atteedda haatsaa elleella wonggiriyaan tigaade, hara haatsaa duuk'k'anaw ollaa wos's'aaddu; gaalatuu ubbay alana gakkanaw, haatsaa ollaappe duuk'k'a duuk'k'aade ahaade wonggiriyaan tigaade ushshaaddu.
I k'oppiide yeedda k'ofaa Med'inaa Goday injjeyiidde de'intto eranaw bitanii c'o"u giide izo s'eellee.
Gaalotuu haatsaa ushi simmiina, bitanii ichcheshu giraamenne bakka gideedda work'k'aa migiduwaanne, s'eetanne tammu giraame gideedda laa"u work'k'aa sagaayetuwaa keseedda;
izo, «Neeni O naatti? Ane taw oda; ne aawuwaa son nuw ak'iyaa sa'ay de'anee?» yaageedda.
Iza, «Taani Baatu'eela naatto; Baatu'eeli Milkka Naakooraw yeleedda na'aa.
Nuwaan gidiyaa dalaynne bassuu de'ee; k'ay hinttenttu ak'anawukka sa'ay de'ee» yaagaaddu.
Bitanii gulbbati Med'inaa Godaw goynniidde,

hawaadan yaageedda; «Ta godaw keekiyaawaanne ammanettiyaawaa aggibeenna Med'ina Goday, ta godaa Abrahaama S'oossay galatetto! Taani yiishshin, Med'inaa Goday taana ta godaa dabbatuwaa soy kaaletseedda» yaageedda.
Naatta wos's'a baade, bare aati son de'iyaa asaw haneeddabaa odaaddu.
Ribik'iw Laabaana giyaa ishay de'ee; Laabaani kare kesiide, haatsaa pulttuwaa matan de'iyaa bitaniyaakko wos's'eedda.

Migiduwaanne bare michchati kushiyaan de'iyaa sagaayetuwaa be'eeddasaana Ribik'a bitanii barena geeddawaa odina sisosaanna, kesiide bitaniyaakko bi be'eedda; bitaniyaa gaalotuwaanna pulttuwaa matan ek'k'eeddawaa demmeedda.
Aa, «Med'inaa Goday neena anjjeedawo, haaya! Neeni hawaan karen ayaw ek'k'ay? Taani new golliyaanne gaalotookka sa'aa giigissaad» yaageedda.
Bitanii soo geleedda; Laabaani gaalotuwaa c'aanaa billeedda; dalaanne bassuwaa gaalotoo yegeedda. Gediyaa meec'c'anaw aasinne aanana de'iyaa asatoo haatsaa aheedda;
k'umaykka Aa sintsa aad'd'eedda. Shin I, «Taani taana aheedabaa hinttenttoo odennan de'aadde k'umaa miikke» yaageedda.
Hewaa diraw I, «Taani Abrahaame k'oomaa.
Med'inaa Goday ta godaa loytsi anjjina, I duretteedda; dorssaa, miizzaa, biraa, work'k'aa, attuma k'oomatuwaa, mac'c'a k'oomatuwaa, gaalotuwaanne haretuwaa aw immeedda.
Ta godaa machata Saara bare c'iimmatetsaa laytsan aw attuma na'aa yelaaddu; I barew de'iyaawaa ubbaa aw immeedda.
Ta goday taana hawaadan c'aak'k'iseedda; ‹Taani de'iyaa Kanaane biittaa mac'c'a naanatuwaappe ta na'aw machchatto oochchoppa;
shin ta aawuwaa asaakko, ta zaratuwaakko baade, ta na'aw machchatto oochcha› yaageedda.
Taani ta godaa, ‹Naatta taananna yaanaw dosennan aggooppe shin?› yaagaad.
I, ‹Med'inaa Goday, taani Aa sintsan hametteeddawe neenana bare kiitanchchaa kiittana; neeni ta na'aw ta aawuwaa asaappe, ta zaratuwaappe machchatto demmana mala, ne biyaasaakka injjeyana.
Neeni ta zaratuwaakko biina, unttunttu new izo immennan is's'ooppe, he wode new c'aak'uu gometenna› yaageedda.
«Taani hachche ha pulttuwaakko yeedda wode yaagaad; ‹Med'inaa Godaw, ta godaa Abrahaame S'oossaw, ne shene gidooppe, taani biyaa yewuwaa injjeya.
Be'a; taani ha pulttuwaa matan ek'k'ay; gellayatta ittina haatsaa tikkanaw yooppe, taani izo, «Taana ne otuwaappe guutsa haatsaa ushshaarikkii!» yaagana.
Iza taana, «Eeno usha; k'ay ne gaalotookka taani haatsaa duuk'k'ana» yaagiyaanna, Med'inaa Goday ta godaa na'aw dooreeddaano gidu› yaagaad.

«Taani ta wozanaan woossiyaawaa wurissenaan de'ishshin, Ribik'a bare otuwaa tookka akkaade, puttu gaaddu; pulttuwaa duge wod'd'aade haatsaa duuk'k'aadu; taani izo, ‹Taana haatsaa ushshaarikkii› yaagaad.
«Iza elleella bare hashiyaappe otuwaa wotsaade, ‹Hekko usha; k'ay taani ne gaalotuwaa ushshana› yaagaaddu. Taani ushaad; k'ay ta gaalotuwaa iza ushshaaddu.
«Taani izo, ‹Neeni O naatti?› yaagaad.

continuations.text: «Iza, ‹Taani Baatu'eela naatto; Baatu'eeli, Milkka Naakooraw yeleedda na'aa› yaagaaddu.
«Taani iziw migiduwaa aatsaad; izi kushiyaankka sagaayetuwaa wotsaad.

verses.text: Hewaappe guyye taani gulbbataade, Med'inaa Godaw goynnaad; taani Med'inaa Godaa, ta godaa Abrahaame S'oossaa, ta godaa ishaa na'aa naatto Aa na'aw akkanaw taana likke ogiyaa kaaletseeddawaa galatay.
Ha"ikka hinttenttu ta godaw keekanabaanne ammanettanawaa gidooppe, taw odite; gidana d'ayinttonne odite; hewaappe sintsan taani hananawaa erana» yaageedda.
Laabaaninne Baatu'eeli zaariide yaageeddino; «Ha yewuu Med'inaa Godaappe yeedda; nuuni new yaa haa gaanaw danddayokko.
Ribik'o hanno be'a; akkaade ba; Med'inaa Goday geeddawaadan ne godaa na'aw machchatto gidu» yaageeddino.
Abrahaama k'oomay unttunttu giyaawaa siseedda wode, sa'aan gulbbatiide Med'inaa Godaw goynneedda.
K'oomay biraa alleek'k'uwaanne work'k'aa alleek'k'uwaa, mayuwaakka kessiide, Ribik'iw immeedda; k'ay al"o miishshatuwaa izi ishawunne izi aatiw immeedda.
Hewaappe guyye, inne aanana de'iyaawanttu meeddinonne usheeddino; yaatiide yan ak'eedino; unttunttu guuran denddiide, «Taana ta godaakko yeddite» yaageedda.
Izi ishaynne izi aata, «Naatta itti tammu gallassaa keeshshaa nuunana takku; hewaappe guyye iza baana» yaageeddino.
Shin I, «Med'inaa Goday taani yeeddawaa injjey diggina, hinttenttu taana gam"etsoppite; taani ta godaakko baana mala taana moyzzite» yaageedda.
Unttunttu, «Naatto s'eesiide ane izo oochchoytte» yaageeddino.
Ribik'o s'eesiide, «Ha bitaniyaanna baanii?» yaagiide oochcheeddino.
Unttunttu barenttu michchato Ribik'o, izo dichchiyaanina, Abrahaama k'oomaananne Aa asatuwaana moyzzeeddino.
Unttunttu Ribik'o,

continuations.text: Ne zaratuu barenttu morkkatuwaa katamatuwaa laattino» yaagiide anjjeeddino.

verses.text: Hewaappe guyye, Ribik'anne izi danggaas'iretuu denddiide, gaalotuwaa toggiide, bitaniyaanna beeddino. Yaatina k'oomay Ribik'o akkiidde beedda.
He wode Yisaak'i, «Taana Be'iyaa De'uwaa S'oossaa Pulttuwaa» giyaa pulttuwaa mata biide, Neegeeba woran de'ee.
Itti gallassi omarssi Yisaak'i bare wozanaan k'oppiide dembbaa kesiide yuuyyee; I d'ok'k'u giide s'eelliyaa wode, gaalatuu yiyaawantta be'eedda.
Ribik'akka d'ok'k'u gaade s'eelliyaa wode, Yisaak'a be'aaddu; gaaluwaappe wod'd'aaddu.
K'oomaa, «Ha nuunana gaketanaw dembbaana yiyaa bitanii oonee?» yaagaaddu.

continuations.text: K'oomay, «I ta godaattee» yaageedda. Iza bare shaashiyaa akkaade gullottaaddu.

verses.text: K'ay k'oomay bare ootseeddawaa ubbaa Yisaak'aw odeedda.
Yisaak'i Ribik'o bare aati Saari dunkkaaniyaa afeedda. Izo akeedda; izakka aw machchatto gidaaddu. Yaatina I izo siik'eeddanne bare aati hayk'k'uwaan kayyottiyaawaappe minetteedda.

notes.text: + Ne kushiyaan ta gulbbataa oyk'k'a: Hawaa guussay c'aak'uu polo laamettenawaa bessee.

verses.text: K'ay Abrahaame K'as'uro geetettiyaa hara machchatto akkeedda.
Iza Ziimiraana, Yok'ishaana, Madaana, Midiyaama, Yishibaak'anne Shuha aw yelaaddu.
Yok'ishaani Saabanne Dadaana yeleedda. Dadaani Ashooreta, Les'uushetanne Le'aamata yeleedda.
Midiyaama naanay Eefa, Eefeera, Hanooka, Abiidaa'anne Elddaa'a. Hawanttu ubbaykka K'as'uri naanaa.
Abrahaame barewaa ubbaa Yisaak'a laatisseedda.
Shin I biro pas'a de'iidde, bare hara machatuwaappe yeleedda naanaatoo barew de'iyaawaappe woyteedda. Bare na'aa Yisaak'appe unttuntta shaakki, away doliyaa bagga biittaw yeddeedda.
Abrahaame mule itti s'eetanne laappun tammanne ichcheshu laytsaa de'eedda.
Abrahaame daro wodiyaa de'iide, lo"o c'imiide hayk'k'eedda; bare mayzzatuwaanna gaketteedda.
Aa naanay Yisaak'inne Isimaa'eeli Aa Maakip'eela giyaa gonggolo duufuwaan moogeeddino; he gonggoluu Mamire matan, Hiitiyaa S'ohaara na'aa Efiroona gadiyaan de'ee.
Hewenne Abrahaame Hiitetuwaappe shammeedda gadiyaa. Abrahaame bare machata Saara moogetteedda sa'aan moogetteedda.
Abrahaame hayk'k'eeddawaappe guyye, S'oossay Aa na'aa Yisaak'a anjjeedda. He wode Yisaak'i, «Taana Be'iyaa De'uwaa S'oossaa Pulttuwaa» giyaa pulttuwaa matan de'ee.
Saari ayilata, Gibs'eppe yeedda Aggaara, Abrahaamew yeleedda na'aa Isimaa'eela yeletay hawaappe kaalliide s'aafetteeddawaa.
Isimaa'eela naanay barenttu suntsaaninne barenttu yeletaa maaran hawantta; hewanttunne: Nabaayoota, K'eedaara, Adibi'eela, Mibssaama,
Mishimaa'a, Duuma, Maasa,
Hadaada, Teema, Yis'ura, Naafiishanne K'eedima.
Isimaa'eela naanay hawantta; unttunttu suntsay unttunttu mootsaaninne de'iyaa sa'aan hawaa. Unttunttu barenttu yaran tammanne laa"u kaappatuwaa.
Isimaa'eeli mule s'eetanne hattamanne laappun laytsaa de'iide, hayk'k'eedda; bare mayzzatuwaanna gaketteedda.
Isimaa'eela zaratuu Gibs'eppe away doliyaa baggan de'iyaa Hawiilappenne Shurappe gidduwaan, Asoora afiyaa ogiyaa matan de'eeddino. Unttunttu barenttu ishatuwaa ubbaanna morkkiyaan de'eeddino.
Abrahaama na'aa Yisaak'a yeletay hawaappe kaaliide s'aafetteeddawaa. Abrahaame Yisaak'a yeleedda.
Yisaak'aw laytsay oytamuwaa gideedda wode, Ribik'o akkeedda; iza Masp'p'es'oomiyaan de'iyaa Sooriyaa Baatu'eela naattiwune Sooriyaa Laabaana michchato.
Yisaak'i bare machata mantsato gideedda diraw, iziw Med'inaa Godaa woosseedda; Med'inaa Goday Aa woosaa siseedda. Yaatina Aa machata Ribik'a shahaaraaddu.
Shin izi ulo giddon de'iyaa naanay mantte gidi uttiide, ittuu ittuwaanna sugetteeddino; yaatina iza, «Hawe taw ayaw hanii?» yaagaaddu. Hewaa diraw Med'inaa Godaa oochchanaw baaddu.
Med'inaa Goday iziw,

continuations.text: K'ay ne gidduwaan de'iyaa laa"u gade asatuu ittuu ittuwaappe shaakettana;

verses.text: Iza yeliyaa wodii gakkina, izi uluwaan mantte attuma naanay de'iino.
Koyro yeletteeddawe arssa; Aa bollaa ubbaa isikii mayyeedda; hewaa diraw unttunttu Aa Eesaw giide suntseeddino.

Hewaappe guyye, Aa ishay yeletteedda; I bare kushiyaan Eesaw ginddiyaa oyk'k'i utteedda; hewaa diraw Aa Yaak'ooba giide suntseeddino. Ribik'a unttuntta yeleedda wode, Yisaak'aw usuppun tammu laytsaa gideedda.
Naanay dic'c'eeddino; Eesay shankkaa hiillaa eriyaa bazuwaa asaa gideedda; shin Yaak'oobi dunkkaaniyaan de'iyaa woppa asaa gideedda.
Yisaak'i Eesaa siik'eedda; ayaw gooppe, I shankkateeddabaappe maanaw doseedda; shin Ribik'a Yaak'ooba siik'aaddu.
Itti gede Yaak'oobi wos'iyaa katsishin, Eesay koshay wod'eeddawe, woraappe yeedda.
Eesay Yaak'ooba, «Taana ha zo'o wos'iyaappe miza; taana koshay wod'eedda» yaageedda. (Hewaa diraw k'ay Aa suntsay Eedooma geetetteedda).
Yaak'oobi Aa, «Koyro taw ne bayiratetsaa zal"a» yaageedda.
Eesay, «Be'a! Taani hayk'k'ana hanay; ha bayiratetsay taw ayaa go"i de'ii?» yaageedda.
Yaak'oobi zaariide, «Ane taw koyro neeni c'aak'k'a» yaageedda.

continuations.text: I c'aak'k'eedda; bare bayiratetsaa Yaak'oobaw zal"eedda.

verses.text: Yaak'oobi Eesaw sooluwaanne missiriyaa wos'iyaa immeedda; I meeddanne usheedda; hewaappe guyye denddiide beedda. Eesay bare bayiratetsaa hawaadan kad'eedda.

notes.text: + Yaak'ooba: Ha suntsaa biletsay, Ginddiyaa oyk'k'iyaawaa giyaawaa.

verses.text: He gadiyaan kase Abrahaame wodiyaan de'iyaa koshaa bolla hara koshay denddeedda; yaatina Yisaak'i Piliss's'eema kaatiyaa Abimeleekekko Garaara beedda.
Med'ina Goday Yisaak'aw k'onc'c'iide hawaadan yaageedda; «Gibis'e gadiyaa duge booppa; taani new odeedda gadiyaan de'a.
Ha gadiyaan amareedawaa takkashsha; taani neenana gidana; neena anjjana; ayaw gooppe, ha biittaa ubbaa taani newunne ne zeretsaw immana; taani ne aawuwaa Abrahaamew c'aak'k'eedda c'aak'uwaa minisana.
Ne zeretsaa saluwaa s'oolinttiyaadan darissana; ha biittaa ubbaa taani unttunttoo immana; sa'aa kawutetsaa ubbay ne zeretsaa baggana anjjettana.
Ayaw gooppe, Abrahaame ta k'aalaa siseedda; ta pirddatuwaanne ta azazuwaa, ta awaayotuwaanne ta higgiyaa naageedda» yaageedda.
Hewaa diraw Yisaak'i Garaaran utteedda.
He biittaa Asay Ribik'ibaa dentsiide Yisaak'a, «Hanna new ayee?» yaagiide oochcheedda.

continuations.text: I, «Hanna taw michchato» yaageedda. Ayaw gooppe, I Ribik'a daro puulanchcha gidiyaa diraw, «Taani, ‹Iza ta machchatto gooppe›, ha gade Asay izi gaasuwaan taana wod'anenttonne» yaagi k'oppiide yayyeedda.

verses.text: Yisaak'i hewaan daro wodiyaa de'owaappe guyye, Pilss's'eema Kaatii Abimeleeki maskkootiyaanna duge s'eeliide, Yisaak'i bare machchatti Ribik'ina gaketishin be'eedda.
Hewaa diraw Abimeleeki Yisaak'a s'eesiide, «Hekko iza tumu ne machchato! Neeni ayaw, ‹Iza ta michchato› gaaddii?» yaagiide oochcheedda.

continuations.text: Yisaak'i, « ‹Iza ta machchatto gooppe›, izi gaasuwaan Asay taana wod'ana gaade gaad» yaageedda.

verses.text: Abimeleeki, «Hawe neeni nu bollan ootseeddabay ayee? Ta asaappe itti Asay ne machchattina gisi diggeeddashin; neeni nu bollan gomiyaa ahaadashin» yaageedda.
Hewaa diraw Abimeleeki bare asaa ubbaa, «Ha bitaniyaa woy Aa machchatto bochchiyaa ooninne tumu hayk'k'ana» yaagiide azazeedda.
Yisaak'i he gadiyaan katsaa zeriide, he laytsan s'eetu kushiyaa c'akkeedda; ayaw gooppe, Med'inaa Goday Aa anjjeedda.
I duretteedda; duretaa bolla duretay aw dari dari beedda.
Yisaak'aw dorssaa wudii, miizzaa wudiinne k'oomatuu loytsi dareedda diraw, Pilss's'eema asatuu Aa k'anaateeddino.
Hewaa diraw, Aa aawuwaa Abrahaame wodiyaan, Aa aawuwaa k'oomatuu bookkeedda haatsaa ollaa ubbaa Pilss's'eema asatuwaa biittaa zaariide bareedino.
He wode Abimeleeki Yisaak'a, «Nuuppe shaakettaade ba; neeni nuuppe aad'd'a minnaadda» yaageedda.
Yisaak'i hewaappe denddiide, Garaara Wombbaa biide yan utteedda.

Yisaak'i bare aawuwaa Abrahaame wodiyaan booketteedda haatsaa ollatuwaa, Abrahaame hayk'k'eeddawaappe guyye, Pilss's'eema asatuu bareedawantta zaari bookki kessiide, Aa aawuu suntseedda suntsan unttuntta s'eeseedda.
Yisaak'a k'oomatuu wombban bookkiide, pulttiyaa haatsaa ollaa yan demmeeddino.
Shin Garaara hentsanchchatuu Yisaak'a hentsanchchatuwaana, «Haatsay nuwaa» yaagiide walak'etteeddino. Unttunttu aanana palumetteedda diraw, Yisaak'i he haatsaa ollaa, «Palumiyaa» giide suntseedda.
Hewaappe guyye, unttunttu hara haatsaa ollaakka bookkeeddino; shin unttunttu he haatsaa ollaa geeduwaan walak'etteeddino; hewaa diraw I he haatsaa ollaa «Morkketiitta» giide suntseedda.

Hewaappe guutsaa zardda''iide, hara haatsaa ollaa bookisseedda; Aa gaasuwaan ooninne walak'ettibeenna; «S'oossay ha"i nuw aasseeda; nuuni ha gadiyaan c'oraana» giide Aa, «Aako sa'aa» giide suntseedda.
Hewaappe denddiide, pude Berssaabehe beedda.

He beedda gallassi k'amma Med'ina Goday Aw k'onc'c'iide Aa, «Taani ne aawuwaa Abrahaame S'oossaa; taani neenana de'iyaa diraw, neeni yayyoppa; taani neena anjjana; ta k'oomaa Abrahaame diraw ne zeretsaa taani c'orissana» yaageedda.
Yisaak'i hewaan yarshshiyaa sa'aa kees's'iide, Med'inaa Godaa suntsaa s'eeseedda. Yan I bare dunkkaaniyaa d'ogeedda; k'ay yan Aa k'oomatuu haatsaa ollaa bookkeeddino.
Hewaappe guyye, Abimeleeki barena zoriyaa Ahuuzatanne bare wotaadaratuwaa kaappuwaa Pikoola akkiidde, Garaarappe Yisaak'akko yeedda.
Yisaak'i unttuntta, «Hinttenttu kase taana is's'iide, hinttenttu biittaappe kessi yeddeeddita; ha"i k'ay taakko ayaa akkana yedditee?» yaageedda.

Unttunttu Aa, «Med'inaa Goday neenana de'iyaawaa nuuni k'onc'c'iyaan be'eeddo. Hewaa diraw c'aak'k'o c'aak'uu nu giddoninne ne giddon de'ana koshshee yaagetto. Nuuni neena bochchibeykko; shin nuuni new keekatetsaa s'alalaa ootsiide, neena sarotetsaan moyzzi yeddeeddo. Hewaaddankka neeni nu bolla iitabaa ootsenna mala, ane neenana c'aak'uwaa c'aak'k'etoytte. Ha"i neeni Med'inaa Goday anjjeedawaa» yaageeddino.
He wode Yisaak'i unttunttoo baalaa giigissina, meeddinonne usheeddino.
Wonttetsa gallassi wontta guuran denddiide, unttunttu ittuu ittuwaanna c'aak'k'eteeddino. Yisaak'i unttuntta moyzzina, unttunttu aappe saro shaakettiide beeddino.
He gallassi Yisaak'a k'oomatuu yiide, barenttu bookkeedda haatsaa ollaabaa aw odeeddino; «Nuuni haatsaa demmeeddo» yaageeddino.
I he haatsaa ollaa Saabehi giide suntseedda; hewaa diraw he katamaa suntsay hachche gakkanaw Berssaabehi geetettee.
Eesaa laytsay oytamuwaa gidiyaa wode, Hiitiyaa Bi'eedo naatto Yooditonne Hiitiyaa Eloona naatto Baasemaato akkeedda.
Unttunttu Yisaak'anne Ribik'o kayyoyiidde de'eeddino.

notes.text: + Berssaabehi: Ha suntsaa biletsay Ibraaweetsuwaan, «C'aak'uwaa haatsaa ollaa» giyaawaa (gujji s'eelite 21:31 ).

verses.text: Yisaak'i c'imina, Aa ayfii s'eelaa is's'eedda wode, bare bayiratiyaa na'aa Eesaa s'eesiide Aa, «Ta na'aw» yaageedda.
I, «Be'a, ha"i taani c'imaad; taani hayk'ana gallassaa erikke.
Yaatiyaa diraw, ha"i ne shankkatiyaa wonddaafiyaanne zubbiyaa akkaade, bazuwaa ba; do'aa taw shankkataade, ashuwaa akkaade ya.
Mal"o k'umaa, taani dosiyaawaa katsaade aatsa; hewenne taani hayk'k'anaappe kase neena anjjanaassa» yaageedda.
Ribik'a Yisaak'i bare na'aa Eesaw odiyaa wode sisaaddu. Eesay do'aa shankkatiide ahanaw bazuwaa beeddawaappe guyye,
Ribik'a bare na'aa Yaak'ooba, «Ne aawuu ne ishaa Eesaw,
‹Do'aa shankkata ahaade, taw mal"o k'umaa taani maanaw katsaa; hewenne taani hayk'k'anaappe kasetaade, Med'inaa Godaa sintsaan neena anjjanaassa› yaagiyaawaa taani sisaad.
Ta na'aw, ha"i taani neena azaziyaawaa loytsaade sisa.
Wudiyaa garssa baade, laa"u bolttiboltta deeshshaa maratuwaa taw akkaade ya; taani ne aabboo mal"o k'umaa I dosiyaawaadan katsana.
Ne aawuu miide hayk'k'ennan kasetiide neena anjjana mala, aw aatsaasa» yaagaaddu.
Shin Yaak'oobi bare aatto Ribik'o, «Ta ishaa Eesaa bollan isikii de'ee; shin ta bollay liik'o.
Ta aawuu taana oyk'k'i be'ooppe shin? Taani Aa c'immiyaawaa aw malatina, taani anjjuwaa diraw shek'aa ta bolla ahanenttone» yaageedda.
Aa daaya Aa, «Ta na'aw, he shek'ay taana gakko. Taani new odiyaawaa ootsa; baade deeshsha maratuwaa taw akkaade ya» yaagaaddu.
Bi ahiide bare daayiw immeedda; Aa daaya mal"o k'umaa Aa aawuu dosiyaawaadan katsaaddu.
Hewaappe guyye, Ribik'a son bare matan de'iyaa bare bayira na'aa Eesaa mayuwaa lo"uwaa ahaade, bare teefa na'aa Yaak'ooba mayzzaaddu.
K'ay he deeshshatuwaa galbbaa Aa kushiyaanne Aa liik'o k'ood'iyaa mayzzaaddu.
Bare katseedda mal"o k'umaanne ukitsaa bare na'aa Yaak'ooba kushiyaan wotsaaddu.
Yaatina I bare aawuwaakko biide geliide, «Ta aawoo» yaageedda.

continuations.text: I, «Abee! Ta na'aw, neeni oonee?» yaageedda.

verses.text: Yaak'oobi bare aawuwaa, «Taani ne bayira na'aa Eesaa; neeni taana azazeeddawaadan taani ootsaad; dendda; dendda uttaade, taani shankkaappe aheedawaa ma; yaataade taana anjja» yaageedda.
Yisaak'i bare na'aa, «Ta na'aw, waata elleella demmad?» yaagiide oochcheedda.

continuations.text: I, «Med'inaa Goday ne S'oossay taana maaddeedda» yaageedda.

verses.text: Yisaak'i Yaak'ooba, «Ta na'aw, neeni tumu ta na'aa Eesenttonne taani oyk'k'a be'anaw ane taakko shiik'a» yaageedda.
Yaak'oobi bare aawuwaa Yisaak'akko shiik'ina oyk'k'i be'iide, «Ha k'aalay Yaak'ooba k'aalaa; shin kushii Eesaa kushiyaa» yaageedda.
Aa kushii Aa ishaa Eesaa kushiyaadan isikiyaana de'iyaa diraw, eribeenna; I erennan Aa anjjeedda.
Aa, «Tumu neeni ta na'aa Eeseyee?» yaagiide oochcheedda.
I, «Ta na'aw, taani neeni shankkateeddawaa maanaw haa aatsa; maade taani neena anjjana» yaageedda. Yaak'oobi aatsina, I meedda; k'ay I aw woyniyaa eessaa ahina usheedda.
Hewaappe guyye Aa aawuwaa Yisaak'i, «Ta na'aw, haaya; shiik'aade taana yera» yaageedda.
Yaak'oobi shiik'iide Aa yereedda; Yisaak'i Aa mayuwaa singgi sisiide, hawaadan yaagiide anjjeedda; «Ta na'aa peenuu Med'inaa Goday anjjeedda goshshaadan sawee.
S'oossay saluwaa c'okkuwaanne sa'aa shic'aa, katsaanne ooratsa woyniyaa eessaa darssiide new immo.

Kawutetsatuu new moodettino; asatuu new gulbbatino. Neeni ne ishatoo goda gida; ne aati zaratuu new gulbbatino. Neena shek'k'iyaawe shek'etteeddawaa gido; neena anjjiyaawe anjjetteeddawaa gido» yaageedda.
Yisaak'i Yaak'ooba anjji wursseeddawaappe guyye, Yaak'oobi bare aawuwaa Yisaak'a sintsaappe kesowaan Eesay shankkaappe puttu geedda.
Ikka k'ay mal"o k'umaa katsiide, bare aawoo aatseedda. Aa, «Ta aawoo, dendda; dendda uttaade, taani shankkateeddawaappe ma; yaataade taana anjja» yaageedda.
Aa aawuu Yisaak'i Aa, «Neeni oonee?» yaagiide oochcheedda.

continuations.text: I, «Taani ne na'aa, ne bayira na'aa Eesaa» yaageedda.

verses.text: Yisaak'i dagammiide kokkoriidde; «Yaatina do'aa shankkateeddawaa akkiidde taw aatseedawe oonee? Taani ha"i neeni yaana sintsan maade, Aa anjja diggaad; tumukka I anjjetteeddawaa gidanawaa» yaageedda.
Eesay bare aawuwaa k'aalaa siseedda wode, bare k'aalaa d'ok'k'u ootsiide, daro yibbaata yeekuwaa yeekkiide bare aawuwaa, «Taana anjja; ta aawoo, taanakka anjja!» yaageedda.
Shin I, «Ne ishay yiide c'immiidde, ne anjjuwaa aki diggeedda» yaageedda.

Eesay, «Aa eriide Yaak'ooba suntseedda; I taana c'immoode, hawe laa"entsuwaa; I ta bayiratetsaa akkeedda; k'ay ha"i ta anjjuwaa akkeedda» yaageedda. K'ay I, «Neeni taw anjjuwaappe ayaanne ashshabeykkii?» yaagiide oochcheedda.

Yisaak'i Eesaa, «Taani Aa new goda ootsaad; Aa ishatuwaa ubbaakka Aa k'oomatuwaa ootsaad; k'ay taani katsaaninne ooratsa woyniyaa eessan Aa minisaad. Yaatina, ta na'aw, new taani ayaa ootsoo?» yaageedda.
Eesay bare aawuwaa, «Ta aawoo, new itti anjjo s'alalay de'ii? Ta aawoo, taanakka k'ay anjja» yaageedda. Hewaappe guyye, Eesay bare k'aalaa d'ok'k'u ootsiide yeekkeedda.
Aa aawuwaa Yisaak'i zaariide,

continuations.text: «Ne de'iyaa ha sa'aa duretetsaappe haakkaade de'ana;

verses.text: Neeni ne mashshaan ak'ana;

continuations.text: Aa morge mitsa ne morggiyaappe olana» yaageedda.

verses.text: Yaak'ooba Aa aawuu anjjeedda diraw, Eesay bare uluwaan Aa morkkeedda; I bare wozanaan, «Ta aawuu hayana mateedda; taani aw kayyotta simmaade, ta ishaa Yaak'ooba wod'ana» yaageedda.
Shin Ribik'a ha bare bayira na'aa Eesaa k'aalaa siseedda diraw, bare teefa na'aa Yaak'ooba s'eesissa ahaade hawaadan yaagaaddu; «Ne ishay Eesay neena wod'iide haluwaa kesanaw halchcheedda.
Hayyanaa ta na'aw, taani new odowaa ootsa. Dendda! Kaaraanen de'iyaa ta ishaa Laabaanakko bak'ata!
Yaataade ne ishaa hank'k'uu dochchana gakkanaw, amareeda wodiyaa aanana de'ashsha.

Ne ishay new hank'k'ettiyaawaa aggiyaa wodenne, neeni Aa bolla ootseeddawaa I dogiyaa wode, taani kiittaade neena yaappe ahissana. Taani itti gallassi hinttenttu laa"uwaappe mela kessana koyikke» yaagaaddu.

Hewaappe guyye Ribik'a Yisaak'a, «Eesay akkeedda Hiitetuwaa mac'c'a naanaa gaasuwaan taani ta de'uwaa shenetaad; k'ay Yaak'oobikka hawanttu mala Hiitetuwaa mac'c'a naanatuwaappe machchatto akkooppe, taani simmi hayk'k'anaw koyaad» yaagaaddu.

notes.text: + Yaak'ooba: Ha suntsaa biletsay Ibraaweetsuwaan, «C'immeedda» giyaawaa.

verses.text: Hewaa diraw, Yisaak'i Yaak'ooba s'eesiide hawaadan anjjeedanne azazeedda; «Kanaane gadiyaa mac'c'a naanatuwaappe new machchatto akkoppa.
Dendda! Ne daay aawuwaa Baatu'eelakko, Masp'p'es'oomiyaa gadiyaa baade yaappe ne daay ishaa Laabaana mac'c'a naanatuwaappe ittinno new machchatto ootsaade akka.
Ubbaa Danddayiyaa S'oossay neena anjjo; I ne yeletaa aasso; neeni itti dere asaa keena gakkanaw neena c'orisso.
Neeni ha"i betetetsan utteedda ha biittaa newaa ootsana mala newunne ne zeretsaw S'oossay Abrahaame anjjuwaa immo» yaageedda.
Yisaak'i Yaak'ooba yeddeedda; Yaak'oobi Masp'p'es'oomiyaa gadiyaa Laabaanakko beedda. Laabaani Yaak'oobanne Eesaa yeleedda aati Ribik'a ishaanne Sooriyaa Baatu'eela na'aa.
Yisaak'i Yaak'ooba anjjeedawaanne, yaappe machchatto akkanaw Masp'p'es'oomiyaa gadiyaa Aa yedeeddawaa, k'ay I Yaak'ooba anjjeedda wode, «Kanaane mac'c'a asaa akkoppa» yaagiide azazeeddawaanne,
Yaak'oobi bare aawuwaanne bare aatonne azazettiide, Masp'p'es'oomiyaa gadiyaa beeddawaa Eesay ereedda.
Eesay hewaan Kanaane biittaa mac'c'awunna bare aawuwaa Yisaak'a ay keeshshaa iitintto akeekeedda.
Hewaa diraw Eesay Abrahaame na'aa Isimaa'eelekko biide, Aa naatto Maahilaato bare machatuwaa bolla gujjiide akkeedda. Iza Nabaayoota michchato.
Yaak'oobi Berssaabeheppe Kaaraane baanaw denddeedda.
I itti sa'aa gakkina away wullina, yan k'ammaa ak'eeda. He sa'aan de'iyaa shuchchatuwaappe ittuwaa akkiidde, bare huup'iyaan borkkotiide he sa'aan gem"isheedda.
I akumuwaa akumeteedda; he akumuwaan gayyiyaa ittuu biittan ek'k'ina, aw s'eeray saluwaa gakkiyaawaan, S'oossaa kiitanchchatuu gi"ishiinanne wod'd'ishin be'eedda;
gayyiyaw bolla s'eeran Med'inaa Goday ek'k'iide Aa, «Taani Med'inaa Godaa, ne aawuwaa Abrahaama S'oossaa, Yisaak'a S'oossaa. Ha neeni giseedda biittaa newunne ne zeretsaw immana;

Ne zeretsay sa'aa shafiyaadan darana; neeni away wulliyaa baggananne, away doliyaa baggana, huup'issananne hirkki baggana de'iyaa sa'aa gakkanaw aakkana; sa'aa bollan de'iyaa Asay ubbay ne baggananne ne zeretsaa baggana anjjettana
Taani neenana de'ay; neeni biyaasa'aa ubbaan taani neena naagana; k'ay taani neena ha gadiyaa guyye zaaraade ahana; taani new ootsana geeddawaa ootsana gakkanaw neena yeggikke» yaageedda.
Yaak'oobi gem"ishuwaappe beegotteedda wode, «Med'inaa Goday tumu ha sa'aan de'ee; taani erabeykkeppe attin» yaageedda.
I yayyiide, «Ha sa'ay wooti yashshii! Ha sa'ay S'oossaa golliyaappe attin, ayinne hara sa'aa gidenna; hawe saluwaa penggiyaa» yaageedda.
Wonttetsa gallassi wontta guuran Yaak'oobi denddiide, bare borkkoteedda shuchchaa akkiidde, tuussaadan essiide, S'oossaw dummayanaw Aa bolla zayitiyaa tigeedda.
Yaak'oobi he sa'aa Beeteele giide s'eeseedda. Shin he katamay hewaappe kase Looza geetettee.

Yaak'oobi hawaadan yaagiide shiik'k'eedda; «Ta aawuwaa soo taani saro simmana mala S'oossay taananna gidooppe, taani biyaa ha buussan taana naagooppenne taw miyaa k'umaanne mayiyaa mayuwaa immooppe, Med'inaa Goday ta S'oossaa gidana;
taani tuussaadan esseedda ha shuchchay S'oossaa golliyaa gidana. Neeni taw immiyaawaa ubbaappe tammuwaappe ittuwaa taani new immana» yaageedda.

notes.text: + Ne baggananne ne zeretsaa baggana: Sa'aa bollan de'iyaa asay ubbay neenanne ne zeretsaa anjjowaadan anjjana mala taana woosana guussaa.
+ Beeteele: Ha suntsaa biletsay Ibraaweetsuwaan, «S'oossaa Golliyaa» giyaawaa.

verses.text: Hewaappe guyye, Yaak'oobi denddi biide, away doliyaa bagga asatuwaa gadiyaa gakkeedda.

Itti haatsaa ollay dembban de'iyaawaa be'eedda; heezzu dorssaa wudii k'ay he ollaa matan giseeddino. Ayaw gooppe, wudii ubbay haatsaa ushiyaawe he ollaappe. He haatsaa ollaa doonaan de'iyaa shuchchay wolk'k'aama.
Dorssaa wudii ubbay hewaan dagatteedda wode, he wudiyaa heemmiyaawanttu haatsaa ollaa doonaappe he shuchchaa gonddorssiide dorssaa ushshiino. He shuchchaa ollaa doonaan zaariide wotsino.
Yaak'oobi unttuntta, «Ta ishatoo, hinttenttu hak'appe yeddite?» yaagiide oochcheedda.
I, «Naakoora na'aa na'aa Laabaana hinttenttu eriiteyye?» yaageedda.
Yaak'oobi unttuntta, «I lo"o de'ii?» yaagiide oochcheedda.

continuations.text: Unttunttu, «Ee, lo"a; Aa naatta Raaheela dorssaa akkaade yewunno hanno be'a» yaageeddino.

verses.text: Yaak'oobi unttuntta, «Be'ite; away ha"i wullibeena; wudiyaa mehii soo shiik'iyaa wodii biro gakkibeenna; dorssaa ha"i ushshi afiide, heemmite» yaageedda.
Shin unttunttu, «Wudii ubbay shiik'ana gakkanaw, shuchchaa haatsaa ollaa doonaappe gonddorssana gakkanaw, nuuni ushshanaw danddayokko. Hewaappe guyye, nuuni dorssaa ushshana» yaageeddino.
I biro haasayishin, Laabaana naatta Raaheela bare aawuwaa dorssatuwaa laagga akkaade gakkaaddu; ayaw gooppe, iza dorssaa hentsanchchaa.

Yaak'oobi bare aati ishaa Laabaana naatto Raaheelo be'eedda wodenne, bare aati ishaa Laabaana dorssaa be'eedda wode, biide ollaa doonaappe shuchchaa gonddorsseedda; bare aati ishaa dorssatuwaa haatsaa ushsheedda.
Yaak'oobi Raaheelo yeriide, nashechchaw bare k'aalaa d'ok'k'isiide yeekkeedda.
Yaak'oobi iziw aawuwaa dabbonne Ribik'i na'aa gidiyaawaa Raaheeliw odeedda. Hewaa diraw iza wos's'a baade bare aawoo odaaddu.
Laabaani bare michchati na'aa Yaak'ooba woriyaa siseedda saannakka, aanana gaketanaw wos's'eedda. Aa idimmi yeriide, bare soo afeedda. Yan Yaak'oobi haneeddawaa ubbaa Laabaanaw odeedda.
Laabaani Aa, «Neeni tumu ta ashonne ta suutsaa» yaageedda. Yaak'oobi aanana itti aginaa kumentsaa utteedda.
Hewaappe guyye Laabaani Aa, «Neeni taw dabbo gideedda diraw, taw c'oo mela ootsaniyee? Ane new ayaa c'igganaw bessintto taw oda» yaageedda.
source_headings_before: Yaak'oobi Raaheeli Dirawunne Liya Diraw Laabaw Ootseedda

verses.text: Laabaanaw laa"u mac'c'a naanatuu de'iino; bayirati suntsay Liyo, teefattiwe Raaheelo.
Liya ayfiyaana c'uuc'a; shin Raaheela geesanchanne malaa lo"a.
Yaak'oobi Raaheelo siik'iide Aa, «Taani ne teefa naatti Raaheeli diraw new laappun laytsaa ootsana» yaageedda.
Laabaani, «Izo hara asaw immanaappe new immiyaawe lo"a; neeni taananna hawaan de'a» yaageedda.
Hewaa diraw Yaak'oobi Raaheelo akkanaw laappun laytsaa ootseedda; shin I izo siik'iyaa diraw, aw amareeda gallassaa malateedda.
Hewaappe guyye Yaak'oobi Laabaana, «Ta machchato taw imma; ta wodii poletteedda; taani izo akkanaw koyaad» yaageedda.
Hewaa diraw Laabaani hewaan de'iyaa asaa ubbaa s'eesiide, bullachchaa keseedda.
Shin sa'ay k'ammina, I bare naatto Liyo afiide Yaak'oobaw immeedda. Yaak'oobi izo akkeedda.
K'ay Laabaani bare k'oomatoo Zilppo bare naatti Liyiw danggaas'ire gidanaadan immeedda.
Sa'ay wonttina s'eelliyaa wode, hekko Liyo! Yaatina Yaak'oobi Laabaana, «Hawe neeni ta bolla ootseeddawe ayee? Taani new ootseeddawe Raaheeli dirassa gidenneeyye? Taana ayaw c'immaad?» yaageedda.
Laabaani Aa, «Nu biittan bayirata de'ishshin, teefatto asinaw immiyaawe woga gidenna.
He mishiraa saaminttaa wurssa; k'ay teefatiyaanokka nuuni new immana; hewaappe guyye, hara laappun laytsaa taw ootsaasa» yaageedda.
Yaak'oobi hewaadan haniide he saaminttaa wursseedda; hewaappe guyye, Laabaani bare naatto Raaheelo aw immeedda.
K'ay Laabaani bare k'oomato Baalo bare naatti Raaheeliw danggaas'ire gidanaadan immeedda.
Yaak'oobi Raaheelo akkeedda. Raaheelo Liyippe aatsiide siik'eedda. Hara laappun laytsaa Laabaanaw ootseedda.
Med'inaa Goday Liya siik'ettabeennawaa be'iide, iziw yeliyaa uluwaa dooyeedda; shin Raaheela mantsato.
Liya shahaaraade attuma na'aa yelaaddu. Aa suntsakka Roobeela suntsaaddu; ayaw gooppe iza, «Med'inaa Goday ta metuwaa be'eedda; ha"i tumu taana ta asinay siik'ana» yaagaaddu.
Iza haraakka shahaaraade attuma na'aa yelaaddu. Iza, «Med'inaa Goday taani siik'ettabeenawaa siseedda diraw, taw hawaakka gujjeedda» yaagaadde, Aa Simoona suntsaaddu.
Aa haraakka shahaaraade attuma na'aa yelaaddu. Iza, «Taani aw heezzu attuma naanaa yeleedda diraw, ta asinay ha"i taananna waas'ettana» yaagaadde, Aa Leewii suntsaaddu.
Aa haraakka shahaaraade attuma na'aa yelaaddu. Iza, «Hachchiwaan taani Med'inaa Godaa galatana» yaagaaddu. Hewaa diraw Aa Yihudaa suntsaaddu. Hewaappe guyye yeluwaa essaaddu.

notes.text: + Roobeela: Ha suntsaa birshshetsay «Hashshu! Attuma na'aa!» woy «Ta metuwaa be'eedda» giyaawaa.
+ Simoona: Ha suntsaa Biletsay Ibraaweetsuwaan, «Siseedda» giyaawaa.
+ Leewii: Ha suntsaa biletsay Ibraaweetsuwaan, «Waas'ettana» giyaawaa.
+ Yihudaa: Ha suntsaa biletsay Ibraaweetsuwaan, «Galataa» giyaawaa.

verses.text: Raaheela Yaak'oobaw naanaa yelabeennawaa be'eedda wode, bare michchato k'anaataaddu; hewaa diraw Yaak'ooba, «Taw naanaa imma; hewe d'ayooppe, taani hayk'k'ana» yaagaaddu.
Yaak'oobi Raaheelo hank'k'etsiide, «Taana new yeluwaa diggeedda S'oossaa gaaddiyye?» yaageedda.
Iza, «Ta danggaas'irato Baalo hinno be'a; iza ta diraw yelana mala neeni izo akka; yaatooppe izi baggana taanikka na'aa daayo gidana» yaagaaddu.
Bare danggaas'iratto Baalo machchatto ootsiide akkana mala, aw immaaddu; Yaak'oobi izo akkeedda.
Baala shahaaraade attuma na'aa Yaak'oobaw yelaaddu.
Yaatina Raaheela, «S'oossay taw daannateedda; ta woosaakka sisiide, taw attuma na'aa immeedda» yaagaaddu. Hewaa diraw Aa Daana suntsaaddu.
Raaheeli danggaas'irata Baala haraa shahaaraade, Yaak'oobaw laa"entsuwaa attuma na'aa yelaaddu.
Raaheela, «Taani ta michchatina wolk'k'aama baas'iyaa baas'etaade s'oonaad» yaagaaddu. Hewaa diraw Aa Nifttaaleema suntsaaddu.
Liya barew yeluu ek'k'eeddawaa be'aade, bare danggaas'irato Zilppo afaade Yaak'oobi izo akkana mala immaaddu.
Liya danggaas'irata Zilppa attuma na'aa Yaak'oobaw yelaaddu.
Liya, «Laa hawe ayaa lo"o kaac'ee!» yaagaaddu. Hewaa diraw Gaada suntsaaddu.
Liya danggaas'irata Zilppa Yaak'oobaw laa"entsuwaa attuma na'aa yelaaddu.
Liya, «Taani ay keeshshaa nashettayttaasha! Mac'c'a Asay taana nashettiyaanno gaana» yaagaaddu. Hewaa diraw Aa Aaseera suntsaaddu.
Zarggaa c'akkiyaa aginaan Roobeeli gade biide, inkkoyiyaa giyaa timaatimiyaa malatiyaa teeraa demmiide, bare aati Liyiw aheedda. Raaheela Liyo, «Ne na'aa inkkoyiyaappe taw imma» yaagaaddu.
Shin Liya, «Ta asina neeni wotsa akkeeddawe gidennaan is's'ina, k'ay ta na'aa inkkoyiyaa akkay?» yaagaaddu.

continuations.text: Raaheela, «Yaatooppe, ne na'aa inkkoyiyaa diraw Yaak'oobi hachche k'ammaa neenanna ak'o» yaagaaddu.

verses.text: He gallassaa omarssi Yaak'oobi woraappe yeedda wode, Liya Aa mokkanaw kesaade Aa, «Neeni taananna ak'ana koshshee; ayaw gooppe, taani ta na'aa inkkoyiyaan neena keraw akka diggaad» yaagaaddu. Hewaa diraw I he gallassaa k'amma izina ak'eeda.
S'oossay Liya woosaa siseedda; iza shahaaraade, ichcheshantsa attuma na'aa Yaak'oobaw yelaaddu.
Liya, «Taani ta danggaas'irato ta asinaw immeedda diraw, S'oossay hewaa keraa taw c'iggeedda» yaagaaddu. Hewaa diraw Aa Yisaakoora gaade suntsaaddu.
Liya haraakka shahaaraade, usuppuntsa attuma na'aa Yaak'oobaw yelaaddu.
Liya, «S'oossay taw al"o imotaa immeedda; taani ta asinaw usuppun naanaa yeleedda diraw, ha"i I taana bonchchanawaa» yaagaaddu. Hewaa diraw Aa Zaabiloona suntsaaddu.
Hewaappe guyye itti mac'c'a naatto yelaaddu; izo Diino suntsaaddu.
S'oossay Raaheelo hassayeedda; izi woosaa sisiide izi yeliyaa uluwaa dooyeedda.
Iza shahaaraade attuma na'aa yelaaddu; «S'oossay ta yeellaa k'aareedda.
Med'ina Goday taw hara attuma na'aakka gujjeerenneeshsha» yaagaaddu. Hewaa diraw Aa Yooseefo suntsaaddu.
Raaheela Yooseefa yeleeddawaappe guyye, Yaak'oobi Laabaana, «Taani ta aawuwaa gadiyaa simmana mala, taana moyzza.
Taani unttunttu diraw new ootseedda ta machatuwaanne ta naanaa hamma; taani baana; ayaw gooppe, taani new ay keeshshaa oosuwaa ootseedentto neeni eraasa» yaageedda.
Shin Laabaani Aa, «Taani new ittibaa oday; Med'inaa Goday ne gaasuwaan taana anjjeedawaa taani be'aaddi.
Ne dirgguwaa taw oda; taani new c'iggana» yaageedda.
Yaak'oobi, «Taani new waata ootseedentto, ne mehiikka waan yeletteeddentto neeni eraasa.
Taani yaanaappe kase new de'iyaa guutsay ha"i loytsi dareedda; Med'inaa Goday neena taani aad'd'eedda sa'aan ubbaan anjjeedda. Shin ha"i, taani ta soo asaw ootsanawe awudee?» yaageedda.
Laabaani, «Taani new ayaa immoo?» yaagiide Aa oochcheedda.

continuations.text: Yaak'oobi, «Taw ayinne immoppa; shin neeni taw ittibaa ootsooppe, taani ne wudiyaa k'aykka heemmananne naagana.

verses.text: Taani hachche ne wudiyaa ubbaa gidduwaana aad'd'ana; hewaan ne dorssaappe punc'c'ariyaa woy gazzaa ubbaa, karetsa dorssaa mara ubbaanne deeshshaappe gazzaanne punc'c'ariyaa ubbaa taani shaakkana; unttunttu ta dirgguwaa gidana.

Hewaa diraw ta s'illotetsay neeni taw c'iggeedda dirgguwaa paydanaw sintsappe yiyaa wode, taw markkattana; ta deeshshaappe gazza woy punc'c'are gidennawe woy karetsa gidenna ay dorssaa maraynne ta matan beettintto, wuu"etteeddawaadan payddettana» yaageedda.
Laabi, «Mayyaad; neeni geeddawaadan gido» yaageedda.

Shin he gallassan Laabi danc'c'aa woy gazza gideedda attuma deeshshaa ubbaa, punc'c'are woy gazza gideedda mac'c'a deeshshaa ubbaa, bootsa gideedda ubbaanne karetsa dorssaa mara ubbaa kessiide, bare attuma naanaa hentseedda.
Yaatiide he wudiyaanna heezzu gallassaa ogiyaa Yaak'oobappe haakkiide beedda. Shin Yaak'oobi atteeda Laabaana wudiyaa heemmeedda.
Yaak'oobi deeshsha loomiyaappe, gumariyaappenne s'ank'k'arssaappe k'ayye gatimaa kessiide, pok'uwaa pok'k'i pok'k'iide, giddo bootsa bagga k'aariide gazzayeedda.
Wudii haatsaa ushanaw yiyaa sa'aa ubbaan, wonggiriyaan, wudiyaa sintsan pok'k'eedda gatimatuwaa wotseedda. Kahowanttu haatsaa ushanaw yiide,
he gatimatuwaa sintsan birasseeddino; unttunttu danc'c'aa, punc'c'arenne gazza maratuwaa yeleeddino.

Yaak'oobi maratuwaa wudiyaappe shaakki dumma wotseedda; atteeda wudiyaa danc'c'anne karetsa gideedda Laabaana mehiyaa sintsa zaareedda. Yaatiide barew wudiyaa dummayeedda; Laabaana mehetuwaanna unttuntta gatsibeenna.
Pas's'anne mino mac'c'awanttu kahiyaa wode awudenne, unttunttu he gatimatuwaa matan birassana mala, Yaak'oobi he gatimatuwaa haatsaa wonggiriyaan, miizatuwaa sintsaan wotsee.
Shin mehetuu laafa gidooppe, unttunttu sintsaan gatimatuwaa wotsenna. Hewaa diraw laafiyaa mehetuu Laabawaa gidina, dariyaawanttu Yaak'oobawaa gideeddino.
Hawaadan haniide, Yaak'oobi loytsi duretiide, daro wudiyaa, mac'c'a k'oomatuwaanne attuma k'oomatuwaa, daro gaalotuwaanne haretuwaa mooddeedda.

+ Gaada: Ha suntsaa biletsay Ibraaweetsuwaan, «Lo"o kaac'aa» giyaawaa.
+ Aaseera: Ha suntsaa biletsay Ibraaweetsuwaan, «Nashechchaa» giyaawaa.
